quest.title: Pizza From Another Land
quest.description: Kiminami Anna from the Kiminami Restaurant seems to be bothered by something...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: Oh, hello. Can I help you with something?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Kiminami Restaurant's pizza...

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: Oh, that pizza tastes really good.

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: But...how do I put this, I'm not very used to its flavor.

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: I just think that if you can mix some of Inazuma's local ingredients into the pizza, such as Lavender Melon...

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: Maybe, the pizza will be more popular with everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Traveler, you've returned.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: How did it go, any feedback?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the customers' feedback...

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Pizza made with Lavender Melon... That's not too complicated...

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: The rest of the ingredients just need to be prepared as usual. Well, since the feedback said to "incorporate some of Inazuma's local ingredients," then I can add some other ingredients...

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Hmm, Sea Ganoderma? Naku Weed? Oh, how about Fluorescent Fungus...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Umm, need some help?

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Oh! I'm sorry, I was busy thinking about what ingredients to put in! Let's see, I don't think there's much Lavender Melon left in the store...

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Traveler, please help me get a Lavender Melon. When it comes to ingredients...this should be all that's missing.

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Mm, I'm counting on you, then. Just one Lavender Melon will do.

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: There are still some other ingredients in stock in the store. Just bring back a Lavender Melon, please.

talks.objective: Bring the Lavender Melon back to Kiminami Anna

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Have you brought the ingredients back with you?

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Thank you, these ingredients will do.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: I wonder what a pizza made with Inazuma's local ingredients would taste like...

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: It's done!

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: This pizza looks... pretty good...

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Thanks for your help, Traveler. Here, these are for you.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: I'll make sure to savor this pizza's taste...

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: If it's not bad...it should be officially launched as a new dish soon.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: *sigh* Maybe I'm really not good at making pizza...

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: Pizza made with Lavender Melon... I wonder how it tastes...
